idea.title: Capacete do mototaxi
idea.text: ponto de mototáxi em Salvador: ele põe o capacete e o capacete fica pousado lá em cima do topete

script.title: Capacete do mototaxi
script.premise: No ponto de mototáxi de uma ladeira de Salvador, Gersinho faz o passo brega ao lado da moto e depois põe o capacete com as duas mãos; o capacete para pousado no alto do topete, 40 cm acima da testa, e ele segue sério.
script.gag_without_sound: o capacete fica equilibrado lá em cima do topete, longe da cabeça, com a fivela balançando

location.place: ponto de mototáxi numa ladeira de casas coloridas

camera.height: altura do peito, a 3 m, do outro lado da ladeira

beats.action: ao lado da moto vermelha, com o capacete branco pendurado no pulso esquerdo, faz o passo brega: quadril pendular e indicador subindo e descendo no tempo
beats.extras: dois mototaxistas de colete conversam no fundo, uma senhora sobe a ladeira com sacola

beats.action: levanta o capacete com as duas mãos e desce sobre a cabeça; o capacete para pousado no alto do topete e ele volta à pose, sério, encarando a lente

script.end_state: capacete branco pousado reto no alto do topete, 40 cm acima da testa, fivela pendurada; ele em pose de assinatura, sério

props.name: capacete aberto branco
props.orientation: pendurado pela fivela no pulso esquerdo no início; no fim, pousado reto no alto do topete, viseira para a lente

props.name: moto 125 cc vermelha
props.orientation: estacionada à esquerda do quadro, de perfil, frente apontando para a esquerda

storyboard_panels.description: pose de assinatura ao lado da moto, capacete pendurado no pulso esquerdo
pico do passo brega, quadril para a direita do quadro, capacete balançando no pulso
capacete erguido com as duas mãos descendo e parando no alto do topete
capacete pousado no alto do topete, mãos de volta à pose, cara séria

script.start_frame: Gersinho de corpo inteiro numa ladeira de casas coloridas, ao lado de uma moto vermelha, de frente para a câmera, mão na barriga com um capacete branco pendurado no pulso, dedo pra cima, topete inteiro visível
script.end_frame: capacete branco pousado reto no alto do topete, bem acima da cabeça, fivela pendurada, ele sério com dedo pra cima

music.trend_sound_hint: brega romântico em alta no Reels BR

script.caption: Capacete é obrigatório. O Gerson cumpre a lei.
script.originality_note: o topete vira pedestal: o objeto não bate nem prende, fica pousado em cima. Primeira locação no Nordeste e primeira ação com objeto nas mãos dele.
brand_safety: sem logo na moto e no capacete
coletes de mototáxi sem texto legível
script.risks: o modelo enfiar o capacete através do topete ou amassar o topete; o capacete escorregar; uma terceira mão. Conferir no painel 3 o capacete parando no alto e no end frame o capacete reto.

en.gag_sentence: At a moto-taxi stand on a sloping Salvador street he does his signature brega step beside a red motorcycle, then lowers a white open-face helmet onto his head with both hands and it comes to rest perched level on the very top of his rigid pompadour, 40 cm above his forehead.
en.location: a moto-taxi stand on a steep street of colorful row houses (yellow, blue, pink facades) in a working-class Salvador neighborhood, cobblestone and concrete pavement, strong morning sun
en.location_map: Frame-left: a red 125cc motorcycle parked in profile, its front pointing to frame-left. Center: him standing on the pavement beside the rear of the motorcycle. Frame-right and background: colorful row-house facades climbing the slope, two moto-taxi riders in green vests standing by their bikes far up the street, a woman walking up the slope.
en.position: standing on the pavement 50 cm right of the motorcycle's rear wheel, centered, chest square to the lens, full body visible from shoes to the top of the pompadour
en.signature_pose: left hand flat on his belly with the white open-face helmet hanging by its chin strap from the left wrist, right index finger raised beside his head, feet together
en.extras_tasks: two moto-taxi riders in green vests chat by their parked bikes far up the street looking at each other, one woman with a shopping bag walks up the slope looking ahead
en.props: exactly one white open-face motorcycle helmet with a black chin strap, hanging from his left wrist, visor side toward the lens; exactly one red 125cc motorcycle parked in profile at frame-left
en.hands: He has exactly two hands: left hand flat on his belly with the helmet strap around the wrist, right hand with the index finger raised.

stages.text: He holds the signature pose from the start frame beside the red motorcycle, the white helmet hanging from his left wrist; breathing lifts the chest, one slow blink.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: same pose, helmet hanging from the left wrist.

stages.text: Real-time, at 95 BPM: he shifts his weight onto his left foot, heel first, then onto his right foot; his hips sway once to frame-left and once to frame-right on the beat; his raised right index finger moves up and down twice on the beat; the helmet swings 5 cm on his left wrist.
stages.facing: chest within 30° of the lens while the hips sway, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: feet together, finger raised, helmet hanging from the left wrist.

stages.text: He takes the white helmet in both hands, lifts it above the top of the pompadour and lowers it straight down; the helmet comes to rest perched level on the very top of the rigid pompadour, 40 cm above his forehead, the black chin strap dangling; the pompadour keeps its outline; he lowers his hands back into the signature pose.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: the helmet perched on top of the pompadour, hands back in the signature pose.

stages.text: Everything holds: the white helmet stays perched level on top of the pompadour, its chin strap swaying twice and settling; he stares into the lens, finger raised. The final frame matches the end frame.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: helmet perched high on the pompadour, deadpan face, finger raised.

en.end_change: the white open-face helmet sits perched level on the very top of the rigid black pompadour, 40 cm above his forehead, visor side toward the lens, its black chin strap hanging down beside the pompadour; both hands back in the signature pose; deadpan face
en.end_props: the helmet perched level on top of the pompadour, the red motorcycle unchanged at frame-left
en.props_lock: Exactly one white helmet: on his left wrist in the first frame, perched on top of the pompadour in the last frame. Exactly one red motorcycle, parked, unchanged.
en.lighting: Strong morning sun from the upper frame-right, crisp shadows on the pavement, bright saturated facades, 5600K.
